requirement.statement: Bun OM SHALL expose public alias-definition and entity-deletion APIs with the same persisted-object semantics as the .NET OM kernel: alias definitions SHALL write the existing alias metadata relations, and entity deletion SHALL physically remove the target entity together with every temporal property row and every incoming or outgoing temporal edge row in one write transaction.

case.given: schema initialization has completed and type Employee exists
case.then: resolveType(runner, 'Staff') SHALL return Employee and createEntity SHALL persist Employee as the entity type

case.given: schema definitions for Employee, Department, works_in, and org_unit exist
case.when: the caller defines aliases member_of to works_in and department to Employee.org_unit
case.then: linkEntities and setProperty through the aliases SHALL use the canonical stored names and canonical reads SHALL return the written values

case.when: the caller redefines the same alias or creates an alias cycle through the public APIs
case.then: the latest definition SHALL be stored and resolution of the cycle SHALL reject with a cycle error

case.given: an entity has multiple property history rows and both incoming and outgoing edge history rows
case.then: the entity, all of its property rows, and every edge touching it SHALL be absent from stored relations while unrelated graph facts remain

case.given: no entity has the requested id
case.when: the caller invokes deleteEntity(runner, entityId) repeatedly
case.then: each call SHALL succeed without changing unrelated facts
